items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I think at this time, it seems to me that I had John Simmons, Gerald Wiggins, Maxwell Davis, and Marshall Royal was playing in this band with me.

ctx.x: The Casbah, that's the name of it, right -- out on Figaro4. Well, with the Casbah, let's see ... I think that was the band where I had -- this was when Les Brown and his band used to come to hear my band play, because we were playing things like "I Got My Love to Keep Me Warm", you know, that hit thing they had, and we were playing Dizzy's "Manteca" and I think at this time, it seems to me that I had John Simmons, Gerald Wiggins, Maxwell Davis, and Marshall Royal was playing in this band with me. And Henry Coker…

And we would play all the big band arrangements, and so all the bands would come and hear us, because I was a stickler for 7 pieces, because you could always get the big band sound out of 7 pieces, if it's voiced correctly.

items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I played in the pit. Lee Young played drums.

ctx.x: No. The Rene Brothers played piano. I played in the pit. Lee Young played drums. I can't remember who else was in the band.
When you said Nat got a job out at Fox Hills, I was that at a club, or --
